purpose: Expose non-dominated trade-offs in certified RT001 V3 metrics without constructing legacy CandidateEvaluation fields or selecting a recommendation.
budget_semantics: Each materialised annual bus-km envelope is evaluated as a separate sensitivity partition; no decision budget is selected.

evidence_completeness_classes.BIDIRECTIONAL_ENGINEERING_RETENTION_AVAI: Stage E reports both BUS_TO_RAIL and RAIL_TO_BUS deterministic engineering-retention metrics.
evidence_completeness_classes.NO_PLANNED_BUS_TO_RAIL_METRIC: The context has no supported BUS_TO_RAIL generalized-access value and Stage E has no BUS_TO_RAIL summary metric for the exact timetable. Missing values are not imputed and rows are not compared against the complete class.

dominance_rule: Within one partition, A dominates B only when A is no worse on every applicable dimension and strictly better on at least one. Exact decimal comparisons use zero tolerance.
equivalence_rule: Rows with identical applicable metric vectors are all retained and their equivalence multiplicity is reported.
missing_value_policy: Never impute. Partition by the declared completeness class and require every applicable value inside that class.
prohibited_reinterpretations: Stage-E deterministic retention or misses as empirical missed-connection probability
resident population accessibility weights as passenger demand
municipal work OD as route-level demand without certified spatial allocation
Stage-C generalized-access screening as demand-weighted GJT improvement
public route count as certified public-pattern complexity
separate uncertainty measures summed into an unverified-elements count
